name: QA / Green the Suite
description: Keeps a target repo's test suite green by fixing SOURCE. Each run: the runner-triager runs the project's gate (install + test [+ build/typecheck/lint per the pack]) and, if green, halts cheaply (SUITE_GREEN); if red, it classifies each failure real / flaky / env and scopes the source. The fixer root-cause-fixes the source for each real regression (never the tests) and re-runs. Before the audit, the orchestrator restores the tests to the run's base SHA in the worktree, so the auditor grades the source against the unedited oracle; any test edit is reverted and never merges. The auditor gates on whole-suite-green (re-run against the restored tests) + root-cause + flaky/env handling and emits SHIP/FIX/BLOCK with a bounded FIX loop. On SHIP the source fixes auto-merge back to the base branch, bounded by writeScope (tests are EXCLUDED, so the team cannot weaken its own oracle). All project specifics (how to install/test, known-flaky list, fix policy) come from this project's pack under .glissa/teams/qa/pack/.

stages.summary: Runs the gate (install + test [+ build/typecheck/lint per the pack]); classifies each failure real / flaky / env; scopes the source. Halts SUITE_GREEN when nothing is red.
Root-cause-fixes the SOURCE within writeScope for each real failure (never a test); re-runs the suite; reports any fix that would need a test edit or an out-of-scope path as un-landable.
Re-runs the gate against the orchestrator-RESTORED tests; gates on whole-suite-green + root-cause-not-mask + flaky/env handled; writes review.md ending in a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdict.
On a final SHIP, summarizes what was red, the root causes, the fixes, and residual risk; writes report.md.
